scenes.location: A cozy local coffee shop with soft lighting and a quiet ambiance
scenes.description: Tyler, Yuna, and Luby are seated at a small corner table, sipping their drinks and engaging in a relaxed but meaningful conversation about life goals and future plans.

characters.name: Tyler Rogers
characters.description: A 26-year-old video editor in a relationship with Yuna. He is thoughtful, considerate, and hesitant when it comes to big life decisions.; 26-year-old /Male/In a relationship, 24 years old; Occupation: Video Editor; Personality: Thoughtful, Hesitant, Considerate, Rational; Values: Commitment, Authenticity, Balance; Interests: Romantic relationships, Friendship, Self-reflection; Experiences: Long-term relationship, Social gatherings with friends, Decision-making regarding future life plans
characters.position: Seated at the table, leaning slightly forward in a contemplative posture

characters.name: Yuna
characters.description: Yuna is a 24-year-old graphic designer and Tyler's girlfriend. She is gentle, persistent, and emotionally expressive; Female; Age: 24; Occupation: Freelance graphic designer; Personality: Empathetic, creative, encouraging; Values: Emotional honesty, partnership, personal growth; Interests: Art exhibitions, journaling, indie music; Experiences: Navigating the challenges of a long-distance relationship with Tyler, recently launching her own design portfolio website, supporting Tyler through a difficult career transition.
characters.position: Sitting across from Tyler, making eye contact with him

characters.name: Luby
characters.description: A 27-year-old musician and Tyler's close friend; Male; Age: 27; Occupation: Aspiring jazz pianist and part-time music teacher; Personality: Laid-back, humorous, empathetic; Values: Creativity, friendship, authenticity; Interests: Improvisational music, indie films, collecting vintage vinyl records; Experiences: Performed at small local venues, helped Tyler through a difficult breakup with emotional support, studied music theory in college.
characters.position: Sitting next to Yuna, occasionally glancing at Tyler with a grin

actions.action: Asks Tyler about his thoughts on marriage
actions.dialogue: Tyler, I know you're not rushing into anything, but I was wondering if you've thought about where we're headed long-term. Marriage is something I want to explore with you.

actions.action: Jokes about the situation to ease the tension
actions.dialogue: Hey, if you two get married, I'll start a band called 'The Newlyweds' and we can play at your reception. Just a heads-up, the budget might be tight.

actions.action: Reflects on the question and responds thoughtfully
actions.dialogue: I do care about you, Yuna, and I value the stability a relationship like ours can bring. But marriage is a big step, and I want to make sure it's the right one. I'm still figuring out what balance looks like for me in the long run.
I get it, Tyler. I just want to make sure we're both on the same page. I'm not trying to push you, I'm just curious about where you see us going.

actions.action: Offers his perspective as a friend
actions.dialogue: You know, Tyler, I’ve seen you two together for years. You’ve got something real. Just don’t let fear of change stop you from something amazing. But hey, no pressure—this is your life.

actions.action: Acknowledges the conversation and shares his feelings
actions.dialogue: Thanks, Luby. I appreciate both of you being here and honest. I don’t want to avoid this, but I need time to think. I value authenticity and don’t want to make a decision that feels forced.

scenes.plot: The group is having a candid conversation about the future of Tyler and Yuna's relationship. Luby's humor helps to keep the atmosphere light, while Yuna gently pushes Tyler to consider marriage. Tyler, being thoughtful and hesitant, shares his internal conflict between stability and personal freedom, showing his rational and considerate nature.
scenes.social_purpose: To explore Tyler's internal conflict regarding marriage while showcasing his values of authenticity and balance, and to highlight the dynamics of his romantic and friendship relationships.
